# Conversation Summary

The user requested implementation of scrollable functionality for the files section in the PRView component. The solution involved restructuring the left panel of the SplitterGroup layout to separate the fixed header (containing file controls and checkboxes) from a scrollable file list area using flexbox (`flex-col`, `flex-1`, `overflow-y-auto`). The implementation preserves all existing functionality including file filtering, sorting, selection, bulk actions, and the splitter resize handle while ensuring the right panel (PRReport) remains fully visible and interactive. The scrollbar appears dynamically only when file content exceeds the container height, with no horizontal scrolling or layout regressions.

# Detailed Task Description: Make PRView Files Section Scrollable

## Task Overview
Enhance the PRView component (`client/src/components/repo/PRView.vue`) to implement vertical scrolling functionality for the files list while preserving the existing splitter layout architecture and maintaining the visibility and functionality of all other UI components.

## Current Implementation Context
According to the source code, the PRView component currently uses a **SplitterGroup** layout with multiple panels:
- **Panel 1** (left side): File selection and filtering interface
- **Resize Handle**: Visual divider between panels
- **Panel 2** (right side): PRReport component displaying file details with `overflow-auto` class

The current structure uses `SplitterPanel` components with defined size properties (`min-size="20"`, `defaultSize="70"`, `order="1"`).

## Specific Requirements

### 1. **Scrollable Files Section**
   - Make the files list in the left panel (`splitter-group-1-panel-1`) vertically scrollable
   - The files section currently displays filtered and sorted files via the `visibleFiles` computed property
   - Apply CSS overflow handling to enable scroll while maintaining the splitter layout
   - Ensure scrollbar appears only when content exceeds container height

### 2. **Maintain Layout Integrity**
   - Preserve the splitter functionality between panels
   - Keep the resize handle functional for resizing between left and right panels
   - Ensure the right panel (PRReport) remains visible and functional
   - Maintain responsiveness across all screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop)
   - Prevent horizontal scrolling in the files section

### 3. **Preserve Existing Functionality**
   - Keep file filtering (`filter` watch and `visibleFiles` computed property) working correctly
   - Maintain file sorting functionality (alphabetical sort by `fileFullName`)
   - Preserve column mapping and profile calculations
   - Keep bulk action modal and chat integration working
   - Ensure file selection checkboxes and interactions remain responsive
   - Maintain avatar group display for file profiles
   - Keep "all/none" selection links functional

### 4. **Component Structure Integrity**
   - Header section (loading progress, commit comparison) should remain sticky or always visible
   - Filter bar with search input and profile avatars should remain accessible
   - File menu items should be scrollable without affecting other sections
   - CodxMenu component should handle scroll properly

## Implementation Details

### CSS Modifications
- Add `overflow-y-auto` or `overflow-auto` class to the CodxMenu component wrapper
- Set explicit `height` or `max-height` constraints on the scrollable container
- Ensure the splitter panel maintains `w-full h-full` (or equivalent) dimensions
- Apply proper flex layout to allow content to expand and scroll
- Consider custom scrollbar styling for better UX

### Files to Modify
- **Location**: `client/src/components/repo/PRView.vue`
- **Specific sections to update**:
  - SplitterPanel with ID `splitter-group-1-panel-1` (left panel containing files)
  - The CodxMenu wrapper element and its container
  - The file tree/list rendering structure within this panel
  - Related CSS classes for overflow handling

### HTML Structure to Modify
```vue
<SplitterPanel id="splitter-group-1-panel-1" ...>
  <!-- Need to wrap CodxMenu to make it scrollable -->
  <CodxMenu class="h-full overflow-auto" ... />
</SplitterPanel>
```

Should become a structure that:
- Creates a scrollable container for the file list
- Keeps the header (checkbox and "Files" title) in a fixed/sticky position
- Allows the file items to scroll independently

### Related Data Structures
The following computed properties manage file data and should continue functioning:
- `visibleFiles`: Filtered and sorted file list
- `defaultExpanded`: Folder expansion state
- `fileMap`: File lookup reference
- `columns`: Column/kanban board mapping
- `profiles`: Profile list derived from files
- `selectedFiles`: Subset of files that are checked

## Testing Considerations
- Verify vertical scroll appears when files exceed container height
- Confirm splitter resize handle works smoothly during scroll
- Ensure file selection, filtering, and bulk actions remain functional
- Test that the PRReport panel on the right stays visible and responsive during scrolling
- Validate responsiveness on various screen sizes (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px+)
- Check that keyboard navigation works within the scrollable section
- Verify smooth scrolling performance with large file lists (100+ files)
- Test filter updates don't break scroll position unexpectedly

## Success Criteria
✓ Files list scrolls vertically with scrollbar visible when content overflows  
✓ Scrollbar is smooth and styled consistently with application theme  
✓ Splitter layout remains intact and functional  
✓ Splitter resize handle responds to user interaction while files are scrolling  
✓ All file operations (filter, sort, select) continue working properly  
✓ Right panel (PRReport) remains visible and interactive  
✓ No layout breaking, component misalignment, or visual regressions  
✓ Header area with filters remains easily accessible  
✓ File list maintains proper indentation and styling during scroll  
✓ Performance is acceptable with large file lists (no jank/stutter)  

## Browser Compatibility
- Ensure compatibility with modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Test on both desktop and mobile viewports
- Verify touch scrolling works on mobile/tablet devices

## Related Components
- **CodxMenu**: The menu component displaying the file tree
- **SplitterGroup/SplitterPanel**: Radix Vue components managing the layout
- **PRReport**: Right panel component for file details
- **API Integration**: File data comes from `localRepoChanges` prop processed in `buildFiles()` method
